subject: banking, mobile money and digital payments: trusting a bank, wallet or payment app to hold or move your money
citation: Factors influencing fintech adoption in SA: branchless mobile banking (Athens Journal of Business)
Determining customer acceptance of digital-only banks in SA (SAJIM, SciELO)
Perceived benefit, risk and trust in fintech adoption, Sub-Saharan Africa (PMC)

claims.text: Cost can discourage adoption when a digital financial service is more expensive than the option it replaces.
objections: Is this cheaper than what I already use?

claims.text: Convenience can encourage adoption when a service saves time and fits a person's existing digital habits.
objections: Can I access it anytime, anywhere, without extra effort?

claims.text: Trust can encourage adoption when security is clear and the provider is known; some people may prefer human help when trust is low.
objections: Do I trust this institution, and can I see the security measures?

claims.text: Adoption is easier when a person has the skills, device, data, and network access needed to use the service.
objections: Do I have the skills and the data to use this without help?

confidence: Mixed-method evidence from selected bank and fintech users in South Africa and a four-country African study. The findings describe factors linked to adoption, not how common they are in the wider population.
